name: September Bushwalk Planning Meeting
description:
The Townsville Bushwalking Club September walk planning meeting will be held on Monday 9 September @ 6pm at Blessed Mary Mackillop Parish meeting room (building behind the Church), 43 Ross River Road Mundingburra. 

We will be discussing walks for the rest of September/beginning of October. If you're interested in joining us on one of these walks please come along.

All welcome.
